definitions.explanation: A dense cluster of bushes, shrubs, or low-growing trees, often found in parks, forests, or gardens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧。
examples.english: The cat hid in the bushes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茂|しげ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I could hear birdsong from within the thicket in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{茂|しげ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{秘密基地|ひみつきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing, having built a secret base deep in the undergrowth.

notes:
Refers to a dense mass of shrubs or low trees growing closely together. Unlike ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (forest) or ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (grove), {茂|しげ}み implies shorter, bushier vegetation that one might push through or hide behind.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茂|しげ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧ — hide in the bushes
- {茂|しげ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ — inside the thicket
- {茂|しげ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かき{分|わ}ける→かき分ける：28182_kakiwakeru⟧ — push through the undergrowth
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茂|しげ}み — grassy thicket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {藪|やぶ} — also means thicket or bush, but often implies a more tangled, wilder mass of vegetation, sometimes with negative connotations (e.g., {藪蚊|やぶか}, bush mosquito)
- ⟦{草|くさ}むら→草むら：29900_kusamura⟧ — patch of tall grass, not necessarily bushes or trees
